items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Old Dr. Weeks, you know, one-legged Dr. Weeks, all that bunch of them. I didn't know him.

ctx.x: You knew Buddy Gara and Bertie Bertrand and all of them?
Bertrand and all of them, yeah. Old Dr. Weeks, you know, one-legged Dr. Weeks, all that bunch of them. I didn't know him. Felix King.
